step1_analysis.description: A single NMOS transistor acting as a switch for an inductive or resistive load. It represents the basic configuration of the driver circuit before the active feedback mechanism (described in the paper) is added.

paper_reference.title: A Novel Active Feedback Flyback With Only 100-mV Inductive Overshoot for a Standard Low-Voltage CMOS Inductive Load Driver, in a Single-Chip Controller for 73 Relays in a POTS/ADSL

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using the square law model for the linear region with SKY130 parameters.
Typical Vth for this process node.

Ileak.description: Leakage current when the switch is off

sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical off-state leakage for a 5um/0.5um device in SKY130.

sky130_expected.calculation: RC time constant of load and parasitic capacitance
sky130_expected.reasoning: Very fast switching expected with a 1k ohm test load and small parasitic C.

Inductive_Overshoot.description: Voltage overshoot above VDD when switching off an inductive load

sky130_expected.reasoning: Without the active feedback circuit described in the paper, an inductive load would cause a massive voltage spike limited only by device breakdown. Thus, it cannot be meaningfully estimated for this bare switch.
Efficiency depends heavily on the load and switching frequency. The paper reports 10%.
Depends on the actual relay load used. For a 1k test load at 1.8V, power is much lower (~3.2mW) than the 1W reported for the full relay array.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure on-resistance, threshold voltage, leakage current, and switching times of the NMOS switch using a resistive load.
step3_testbench.spice:
* NMOS Switch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

XM1 N1 IN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
RL VDD N1_R 1k
VID N1_R N1 0
VIN IN 0 DC 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)

.control
* 1. OP for leakage current
op
let ileak = i(VID)
print ileak

* 2. DC Sweep for Vth and Ron
dc VIN 0 1.8 0.01
let ron = v(N1) / i(VID)
meas dc Ron_val find ron at=1.8
meas dc Vth_val when i(VID)=1uA

* 3. Transient for switching times
tran 0.01n 30n
meas tran t_turn_on trig v(IN) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran t_turn_off trig v(IN) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1

quit
.endc

.end
